train_manual.screen.title: Train Command Manual
train_manual.screen.hint: Pick a category on the left · PageUp/PageDown to flip pages · scroll wheel to scroll · click a command to copy
train_manual.screen.footer_hint: Left/Right: category  Up/Down: scroll  Click name: command  Click usage: full syntax
train_manual.entry.sre.help.name: Help Index
train_manual.entry.sre.help.desc: List every command of this mod by category in game; you can also run /sre:help <category>.
train_manual.entry.tmm.start.name: Start Game
train_manual.entry.tmm.start.desc: Start the given game mode. By default only players in the prep area join; add a start delay in minutes, or force_all_players to include everyone.
train_manual.entry.tmm.stop.name: Stop Game
train_manual.entry.tmm.stop.desc: Stop the running game; use force to end it immediately.
train_manual.entry.tmm.config.name: Runtime Config
train_manual.entry.tmm.config.desc: View and modify SRE / Harpy / Noelle config at runtime: reload, reset, set the current round, or toggle automatic train resets.
train_manual.entry.tmm.afk.name: AFK Management
train_manual.entry.tmm.afk.desc: Manage idle detection: reset the timer, check status, or set AFK time for yourself or another player.
train_manual.entry.tmm.money.name: Coin
train_manual.entry.tmm.money.desc: View, set, or add to a player's coin balance.
train_manual.entry.tmm.mood.name: Mood / Sanity
train_manual.entry.tmm.mood.desc: View or set a player's mood (SAN) value, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0.
train_manual.entry.tmm.autostart.name: Auto Start
train_manual.entry.tmm.autostart.desc: Set a 0~60 second countdown to auto-start the game; 0 disables it.
train_manual.entry.tmm.votemap.name: Open Map Vote
train_manual.entry.tmm.votemap.desc: Start a map vote and control it: check status, pause, resume, stop, or set a preset game mode. Defaults to 20 seconds.
train_manual.entry.tmm.switchmap.name: Select / Switch Map
train_manual.entry.tmm.switchmap.desc: Switch server maps: load a map, list all maps, pick a random one, or scan available maps.
train_manual.entry.tmm.fourthroom.name: Fourth Room
train_manual.entry.tmm.fourthroom.desc: Manage the fourth-room card game: check status, play cards, buy items, end the turn, etc.
train_manual.entry.tmm.createpoint.name: Create Waypoint
train_manual.entry.tmm.createpoint.desc: Create a waypoint at the given position, named in the path/name format.
train_manual.entry.tmm.togglewaypoints.d: Admin control over waypoint visibility, per player, per path, or globally.
train_manual.entry.tmm.showstats.name: View Stats
train_manual.entry.tmm.showstats.desc: View your own game stats; admins may view other players' stats.
train_manual.entry.tmm.showselectedmapui: Show the voting interface of the currently selected map.
train_manual.entry.tmm.netstats.name: Network Stats (Server)
train_manual.entry.tmm.netstats.desc: Server packet and HTTP/SQL traffic stats, with rankings by count/bytes/endpoint; exports JSON to the server's netstats/ directory.
train_manual.entry.tmm.netstatsc.name: Network Stats (Client)
train_manual.entry.tmm.netstatsc.desc: Client packet and HTTP traffic stats; exports JSON to .minecraft/netstats/.
train_manual.entry.tmm.giveroomkey.name: Give Room Key
train_manual.entry.tmm.giveroomkey.desc: Give the executor a key item for the specified room.
train_manual.entry.tmm.participate.name: Participation
train_manual.entry.tmm.participate.desc: Manage whether you join the next round: join, leave, toggle, or view status.
train_manual.entry.tmm.entity_interact_c: Attach custom persistent string data to the selected entity.
train_manual.entry.tmm.reload.name: Reload Basic Config
train_manual.entry.tmm.reload.desc: Reload the default prep area or the map vote configuration.
train_manual.entry.tmm.skinsync.name: Skin Sync
train_manual.entry.tmm.skinsync.desc: Manage remote item-skin sync: configure the server, sync, pull, enable, or disable.
train_manual.entry.tmm.skins.name: Item Skins
train_manual.entry.tmm.skins.desc: Manage item skins and see which skins a player has equipped.
train_manual.entry.forceteam.name: Force Player Team
train_manual.entry.forceteam.desc: Force a player into a given team, or reset their team weights.
train_manual.entry.listgameroles.name: List Round Roles
train_manual.entry.listgameroles.desc: List every player's role and modifier for this round.
train_manual.entry.stop_when_over.name: Auto Stop Server
train_manual.entry.stop_when_over.desc: Toggle automatically shutting down the server when the game ends.
train_manual.entry.sre.narrator.name: Narrator
train_manual.entry.sre.narrator.desc: Send a TTS narration to a player, optionally interrupting the current announcement.
train_manual.entry.sre.custom_replay.des: Record a custom (or hidden) event marker in the game replay.
train_manual.entry.sre.show_replay.name: Show Replay
train_manual.entry.sre.show_replay.desc: Show the generated game replay to a player.
train_manual.entry.sre.replay_screen.des: Manage the replay big screen: create, remove, list, set as default, or display.
train_manual.entry.sre.kick.name: Kick
train_manual.entry.sre.kick.desc: Kick the specified non-OP player, optionally with a reason.
train_manual.entry.sre.shield.name: Shield Management
train_manual.entry.sre.shield.desc: Manage normal/timed/weak shields. Timed shields take a duration (seconds) and whether to reset/reset-stack the timer; weak shields take a duration and the death cause to block (* for any).
train_manual.entry.sre.poison.name: Poison Management
train_manual.entry.sre.poison.desc: Apply/remove/trigger poison or fake poison. set takes game ticks (1s = 20 ticks); trigger activates the current poison immediately and is fatal (fake poison is fatal too).
train_manual.entry.sre.stamina.name: Stamina
train_manual.entry.sre.stamina.desc: Add to or set a player's sprint stamina.
train_manual.entry.sre.entitydisguise.de: Disguise a player entirely as any entity (model swap + eye height change, hitbox unchanged). The appearance NBT is also readable by /data and /execute if data.
train_manual.entry.sre.morph.name: Player Morph
train_manual.entry.sre.morph.desc: Morph via MorphApi: copy another player's skin, pick a random living player, or use a custom texture. Automatically cleared at game start/end.
train_manual.entry.sre.inventory.name: View Inventory
train_manual.entry.sre.inventory.desc: View a target player's inventory in a GUI.
train_manual.entry.sre.invsee.name: View Inventory (Alias)
train_manual.entry.sre.invsee.desc: Alias of /sre:inventory; also opens the target player's inventory in a GUI.
train_manual.entry.sre.monitor.name: Security Monitor
train_manual.entry.sre.monitor.desc: Search near a block and configure security camera positions.
train_manual.entry.sre.vote.name: Vote System
train_manual.entry.sre.vote.desc: A full in-game voting system: build options (player/text/item), start, pause, resume, stop, and read results.
Reload all custom role configs and re-sync them to clients.
train_manual.entry.sre.area_manager.name: Area Manager
train_manual.entry.sre.area_manager.desc: Manage per-map areas: spawns, regions, environment, and rooms; set/view/save/load/import map data.
train_manual.entry.sre.pass.name: Pass / Team Card
train_manual.entry.sre.pass.desc: Activate a team card / progression pass.
train_manual.entry.sre.roster.name: Role Roster
train_manual.entry.sre.roster.desc: Open the role rotation roster; admins can edit, enable, disable, draw randomly, and check status.
train_manual.entry.sre.scene.name: Scene Management
train_manual.entry.sre.scene.desc: Manage scene assets and scene configuration.
train_manual.entry.sre.camera.name: Advanced Camera
train_manual.entry.sre.camera.desc: Advanced camera controls for filming and spectating.
train_manual.entry.sre.subtitle.name: Subtitle
train_manual.entry.sre.subtitle.desc: Show a subtitle in the center, at the top, or at the bottom of the screen.
train_manual.entry.sre.eggclear.name: Clear Cuckoo Eggs
train_manual.entry.sre.eggclear.desc: Clear Cuckoo egg entities within range.
train_manual.entry.sre.infected.name: Infection
train_manual.entry.sre.infected.desc: Set the duration (in game ticks) of a player's infection.
train_manual.entry.sre.helium.name: Helium Voice
train_manual.entry.sre.helium.desc: Apply a helium-voice effect to a player, optionally with a duration in seconds.
train_manual.entry.sre.block_cmd_perm.de: When enabled, raises command blocks and entity-interaction blocks to permission level 3 and persists it. Run with no args to check status.
train_manual.entry.tmm.game.name: Game Tools Group
train_manual.entry.tmm.game.desc: Aggregate command group for in-game control: visuals, timers, penalties, roles, events, etc.
train_manual.entry.tmm.game.visual.name: Visual Effects
train_manual.entry.tmm.game.visual.desc: Toggle snow, sand, fog, and HUD; set train speed and time of day; or reset all visual effects.
train_manual.entry.tmm.game.time.name: Set Game Time
train_manual.entry.tmm.game.time.desc: Check the current game countdown, or use set to change the remaining time (minutes/seconds). For time of day see Visual Effects.
train_manual.entry.tmm.game.penalty.name: Death Penalty
train_manual.entry.tmm.game.penalty.desc: Start or stop the death penalty; it can be bound to an entity or a position.
train_manual.entry.tmm.game.bounds.name: Play Bounds
train_manual.entry.tmm.game.bounds.desc: Toggle whether players are confined to the play bounds.
train_manual.entry.tmm.game.abilities.de: View or modify mayfly/flying/instabuild/invulnerable/flying_speed/walk_speed; reset restores defaults.
train_manual.entry.tmm.game.role.name: In-game Role Tools
train_manual.entry.tmm.game.role.desc: In-game role tools: silent change, welcome message, role sync, run/remove assignment events.
The Murder-mode random time-event system: manage events, HUD, default pool, and triggers.
train_manual.entry.tmm.game.tests.name: Test Tools
train_manual.entry.tmm.game.tests.desc: Test role mechanics such as rain summoning, gambler draws/miracles, and math problems.
train_manual.entry.tmm.game.tasks.name: Task Queue
train_manual.entry.tmm.game.tasks.desc: Clear or cancel queued/listed server tasks.
train_manual.entry.tmm.game.win.name: Trigger Win
train_manual.entry.tmm.game.win.desc: Manually trigger the win condition, optionally with a custom color or fully custom text.
train_manual.entry.tmm.game.reset.name: Reset Map
train_manual.entry.tmm.game.reset.desc: Reset map blocks from a backup or with the simple method, and clear entities.
train_manual.entry.tmm.game.scan.name: Scan Map
train_manual.entry.tmm.game.scan.desc: Scan and update map data such as reset points and task points.
train_manual.entry.tmm.game.blackout.des: Trigger or stop the whole-map lights-out effect.
train_manual.entry.tmm.game.monitor_brok: Trigger or stop the security-monitor-broken effect.
train_manual.entry.tmm.game.psycho.name: Psycho Effect
train_manual.entry.tmm.game.psycho.desc: Trigger or stop the psychological screen effect.
train_manual.entry.tmm.game.body.name: Corpse
train_manual.entry.tmm.game.body.desc: Spawn a corpse, or run a command as a corpse.
train_manual.entry.tmm.game.revive.name: Revive
train_manual.entry.tmm.game.revive.desc: Revive a player at their corpse position or at given coordinates.
train_manual.entry.tmm.game.kill.name: Kill Player
train_manual.entry.tmm.game.kill.desc: Kill a player with the given death cause; optionally set the killer, corpse spawning, and force flags.
train_manual.entry.tmm.game.use_skill.de: Trigger a role skill server-side; pick the skill index and target, and use as to specify the caster.
train_manual.entry.tmm.game.timestop.des: Start or stop the global time-stop effect with a notification message.
train_manual.entry.changerole.name: Change Role
train_manual.entry.changerole.desc: Change a player's role; control whether it is recorded in replays and counted in stats.
train_manual.entry.changemodifier.name: Change Modifier
train_manual.entry.changemodifier.desc: Add, remove, or toggle a modifier for a player.
train_manual.entry.forcerole.name: Force Player Role
train_manual.entry.forcerole.desc: Force a specified role for a player on the next assignment.
train_manual.entry.forcemodifier.name: Force Modifier
train_manual.entry.forcemodifier.desc: Force-assign a modifier to a player.
train_manual.entry.setrolecount.name: Set Faction Count
train_manual.entry.setrolecount.desc: Override the automatically calculated killer/vigilante/neutral counts; reset (or no args) restores automatic calculation.
train_manual.entry.setroleweight.name: Set Role Weight
train_manual.entry.setroleweight.desc: Set the spawn weight of a given role type.
train_manual.entry.myroleweight.name: My Role Weights
train_manual.entry.myroleweight.desc: View your own weights for each role.
train_manual.entry.playerroleweight.name: Player Role Weights
train_manual.entry.playerroleweight.desc: View or set a specified player's weights for each role.
train_manual.entry.togglecustomroleweigh: Enable or disable the custom role weight system.
train_manual.entry.setoccupationrole.des: Set the paired-spawn relationship between two roles.
train_manual.entry.setenabledrole.name: Enable / Disable Role
train_manual.entry.setenabledrole.desc: Control which roles are available this round: enable all, disable all, or toggle one by one.
train_manual.entry.setenabledmodifier.de: Control which modifiers are available this round: enable all, disable all, or toggle one by one.
train_manual.entry.setcompanionrole.name: Set Companion Role
train_manual.entry.setcompanionrole.desc: Bind a main role to a companion role so they spawn as a pair.
train_manual.entry.listroles.name: listrole - List Roles
train_manual.entry.listroles.desc: List all registered roles page by page; page 1 is shown if omitted.
train_manual.entry.managerolesui.name: Role Management UI
train_manual.entry.managerolesui.desc: Open the role management GUI to inspect roles and modifiers.
train_manual.entry.broadcast.name: Broadcast
train_manual.entry.broadcast.desc: Broadcast a formatted message to all players.
train_manual.entry.noellesroles.preset.d: Save and apply role configuration presets: apply, list, create, delete, save.
train_manual.entry.noellesroles.setmax.d: Set the maximum number of a given role allowed per round.
train_manual.entry.room.name: Room
train_manual.entry.stuck.name: Stuck Rescue
train_manual.entry.stuck.desc: Teleport to a safe position when stuck inside blocks.
train_manual.entry.vt_mode.name: Streamer Mode
train_manual.entry.vt_mode.desc: Toggle streamer (VTuber) mode for yourself or a player.
train_manual.entry.nr_free_cam.name: Free Camera
train_manual.entry.nr_free_cam.desc: Exit the death penalty and restore free spectator camera.
train_manual.entry.displayitem.name: Display Item
train_manual.entry.displayitem.desc: Show information about the held item in the chat box.
train_manual.entry.cooldown.name: Cooldown
train_manual.entry.cooldown.desc: Set the cooldown of an item skill for a player.
train_manual.entry.item.name: Extra Items
train_manual.entry.item.desc: Manage players' extra item slots: add, set, view, and remove.
train_manual.entry.goods.add.name: Add Product
train_manual.entry.goods.add.desc: Add a vending-machine product at the given position and slot, optionally with a price.
train_manual.entry.goods.remove.name: Remove Product
train_manual.entry.goods.remove.desc: Remove a vending-machine product at the given position and slot.
train_manual.entry.goods.list.name: List Products
train_manual.entry.goods.list.desc: List products configured at the given position.
train_manual.entry.sre.give.name: Give Custom Content
train_manual.entry.sre.give.desc: Give a custom train item or block; items support vanilla component syntax. Omit the player to give it to yourself.
train_manual.entry.sre.setblock.name: Place Custom Block
train_manual.entry.sre.setblock.desc: Place a custom block at the given coordinates.
train_manual.entry.sre.clone.name: Clone Area
train_manual.entry.sre.clone.desc: Clone an entire region (including block entities and custom block ids), chunk by chunk per tick.
train_manual.entry.sre.reload.name: Reload All Custom Content
train_manual.entry.sre.reload.desc: With no args reloads all custom content; you can also reload just one category.
train_manual.entry.sre.reload.custom_rol: Reload only the custom role configs and sync them to clients.
train_manual.entry.sre.reload.custom_mod: Reload only the custom modifier configs and sync them to clients.
train_manual.entry.sre.reload.custom_ite: Reload only the custom train item configs and sync them to clients.
train_manual.entry.sre.reload.custom_blo: Reload only the custom block configs and sync them to clients.
train_manual.entry.nametag.add.name: Add Nametag
train_manual.entry.nametag.add.desc: Add a custom nametag to a player.
train_manual.entry.nametag.remove.name: Remove Nametag
train_manual.entry.nametag.remove.desc: Remove a specified nametag from a player.
train_manual.entry.nametag.set.name: Set Nametag
train_manual.entry.nametag.set.desc: Set a player's current nametag, replacing the existing one.
train_manual.entry.nametag.get.name: View Nametag
train_manual.entry.nametag.list.name: List Nametags
train_manual.entry.nametag.list.desc: List all nametags of a player.
train_manual.entry.nametag.clear.name: Clear Nametags
train_manual.entry.nametag.clear.desc: Clear all nametags of a player.
train_manual.entry.nametag.sync.name: Sync Nametags
train_manual.entry.nametag.sync.desc: Sync a player's nametags to all clients.
train_manual.entry.sre.client.name: Client Settings
train_manual.entry.sre.client.desc: Client-side commands for local settings, UI, and configuration.
train_manual.entry.sreclient.scene.name: Client Scene
train_manual.entry.sreclient.scene.desc: Client-side scene asset commands, executed only on the client.
train_manual.entry.kill.name: Kill (Overridden)
train_manual.entry.kill.desc: Vanilla /kill is overridden by this mod: players need permission level 3, command blocks level 2.
